summary: B1 complete: VM clippy clean, 33 tests passing, wasm compilation passing; no commits.
body:
Changed only [header.rs](/home/admin/src/filmcraft-wt/proto/crates/scenerender/src/header.rs), [timing.rs](/home/admin/src/filmcraft-wt/proto/crates/scenerender/src/timing.rs), [discover.rs](/home/admin/src/filmcraft-wt/proto/crates/scenerender/src/discover.rs), [args.rs](/home/admin/src/filmcraft-wt/proto/crates/scenerender/src/args.rs), and [Cargo.toml](/home/admin/src/filmcraft-wt/proto/crates/scenerender/Cargo.toml) (proptest dev-dependency). All four Rust files were rustfmt-ed.

Public API (`Result<T>` below means `filmcraft_media::Result<T>`):

```rust
// header
pub struct SceneHeader {
    pub width: u32,
    pub height: u32,
    pub fps: FrameRate,
    pub duration: Tick,
    pub has_audio: bool,
    pub asset_refs: Vec<String>,
}
pub fn parse(bytes: &[u8]) -> Result<SceneHeader>;
impl SceneHeader { pub fn frame_count(&self) -> u64; }

// timing
pub fn frame_count(duration: Tick, fps: FrameRate) -> u64;
pub fn frame_at(t: Tick, fps: FrameRate, count: u64) -> u64;
pub fn frame_time(k: u64, fps: FrameRate) -> Option<Tick>;
pub fn chunk(k: u64, len: u64, count: u64) -> Range<u64>;

// discover
pub struct Config { pub program: Option<PathBuf> }
pub struct Version { pub major: u32, pub minor: u32, pub patch: u32 }
pub const MIN_VERSION: Version; // 0.5.0
pub struct Capabilities { pub engine_version: String, pub schema: String }
pub struct Status {
    pub found: bool,
    pub path: Option<String>,
    pub version: Option<String>,
    pub schema: Option<String>,
    pub reason: Option<String>,
}
pub fn locate(config: &Config, env: impl Fn(&str) -> Option<OsString>,
              is_file: impl Fn(&Path) -> bool) -> Option<PathBuf>;
pub fn locate_system(config: &Config) -> Option<PathBuf>;
pub fn parse_version(stdout: &str) -> Option<Version>;
pub fn parse_capabilities(json: &str) -> std::result::Result<Capabilities, String>;

// args
pub fn render_args(doc: &Path, frames: Range<u64>, pattern: &Path,
                   quality: Quality) -> Result<Vec<OsString>>;
pub fn audio_args(doc: &Path, wav: &Path) -> Result<Vec<OsString>>;
pub fn version_args() -> Vec<OsString>;
pub fn capabilities_args() -> Vec<OsString>;
```

Design notes:

- Header parsing uses interchange’s bounded reader and value parsers. Dimensions are capped at 16,384 per side; references at 4,096 distinct values, each at most 4,096 bytes. SVG geometry paths are excluded. Audio detection includes video assets and generated speech/music/sound effects.
- Renderer source uses a **one-nanosecond time tolerance**, equivalent to `1e-9 × fps` frames. Integer timing implements that rule. Tests compare seconds→Tick counts at 24, 25, 30000/1001, and 60 fps.
- Nonintegral frame starts round upward to the first tick inside that frame. Unrepresentable starts return `None`; overflowing counts saturate.
- Discovery is bounded and injectable. Real environment/filesystem access is native-only; `locate_system` returns `None` on wasm.
- CLI flags match renderer source. Audio requires an absolute UTF-8 `.wav` output because encode’s output parameter is a string and its extension selects native WAV delivery.

TDD log: initial VM run compiled the stubs and produced **29 failures / 3 passes**. Every failure below passed in the subsequent **32/32 green run**. Names are relative to each module’s `tests` namespace:

| args | `probe_vectors_match_cli` | `[]` differed from `--version` |
| args | `rejects_relative_paths_and_empty_ranges` | Missing `Unsupported` error |
| args | `render_preserves_non_utf8_paths_but_encode_requires_utf8_output` | Missing document argument |
| args | `render_vector_matches_cli_for_every_quality` | `[]` differed from render vector |
| discover | `capabilities_read_required_fields_and_ignore_extensions` | Empty fields differed from 0.5.0 / 1.7.0 |
| discover | `capabilities_reject_bad_format_shape_and_gigantic_input` | Empty input accepted |
| discover | `discovery_precedence_and_missing_candidate_fallbacks` | `None` instead of preferred path |

| timing | `starts_are_exact_or_rounded_up_without_overflow` | `None` instead of frame-start tick |

An intervening compile failure in `locate_system` was fixed by wrapping generic `var_os` in a closure. Review then added `header::tests::geometry_paths_are_not_file_references`: **red** included two SVG paths in the reference list; **green** retained only movie/poster/thumbnail files.

Final VM command completed successfully:

```sh
cargo clippy -p filmcraft-scenerender --all-targets -- -D warnings
cargo test -p filmcraft-scenerender
cargo check -p filmcraft-scenerender --lib --target wasm32-unknown-unknown
```

Results: clippy clean; **33 tests passed, 0 failed**, 0 doctests; wasm compilation passed. All builds/tests ran through the VM wrapper. Final whitespace check passed.

Integrator: regenerate `Cargo.lock` for the added proptest dependency; it was outside my edit scope. `lib.rs` is unchanged. B1 is complete, with no commits, pushes, or git configuration changes.
